notes.title: StageX 0.1.4.1081 update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29154804/f6af9df143a4cdb80c72d822e91dbc1f6681034a.png

Hello, community! 
We have published this update 18.09.2017 but, by some mistake, did not published the news about it. Sorry. 
Well, this version contain :

General:

[olist]
     Added support for Oculus Rift and Rift Touch
     The shader of hands has been changed.
     The functional of the hands is divided, now every including of collisions and snapping
    On the preview camera added lens switching
    On the preview of the camera, the screenshot button is added
    Added Non uniform scale with information on distance information on the axes.
    The last player position is saved
[/olist]

Export and Import Movie:
[olist]
    Added information when exporting video
    Added the ability to import audio files
    Added audio track to the editing table and final output to the final audio file
[/olist]

- Fixed an issue with scrollbar (when it was too hard to pick)
